（正文）：
In connection with the abduction of the five male Chinese officials of the Kuomintang by members of the Japanese Gendarmerie which took place on May 9 in the Foo Lai Jewish Curry Restaurant, the following information has been obtained from a reliable source :

As previously reported, it was WOO NYI KENG (吳義耕) alias WOO CHUAN YUNG (吳垂) who was responsible for the dinner party in the Foo Lai Restaurant at which the four others namely, CHIANG HOU (姜豪), CHEN CHIA MO (陳嘉謨), SOO LIANG JU (蘇亮如) and HUNG KWANG HWA (洪光華) were present. The five officials met in the restaurant to sign a form pledging their allegiance to the Three People Principles; to unite in spirit and endeavour to work for the welfare of the Nation and thereby become sworn brothers. Before this procedure could take place, the Japanese members of the Gendarmerie appeared and took the five victims, together with the pledge forms away in a motor car which was parked outside the restaurant, and smuggled them via Canton Road, The Bund and Garden Bridge to the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters now established in the defunct China Wing On Finance Company (永安銀行公司), on the ground floor of the Bridge House, North Szechuen Road.

（正文）：
关于5月9日在福来犹太咖喱餐馆发生的日本宪兵队成员绑架五名国民党中国官员一事，已从可靠来源获得如下信息：

如前所述，负责在福来餐馆举办晚宴的是吴义耕（WOO NYI KENG），又名吴垂（WOO CHUAN YUNG），出席者另有四人，即姜豪（CHIANG HOU）、陈嘉谟（CHEN CHIA MO）、苏亮如（SOO LIANG JU）和洪光华（HUNG KWANG HWA）。这五名官员在餐馆会面，旨在签署一份宣誓效忠三民主义的文件；他们在精神上团结一致，努力为国家福利工作，并由此结为异姓兄弟。在此程序进行之前，日本宪兵队成员出现，将五名受害者连同誓约文件一起带走，装入停在餐馆外的一辆汽车，经由广东路、外滩和外白渡桥，将他们秘密押送至位于北四川路大桥公寓（Bridge House）底层的原中国永安银行公司（China Wing On Finance Company）内的日本宪兵队总部。

CHIANG HOU, WOO NYI KENG and CHEN CHIA MO
were confined in one cell, while SOO LIANG JU and
HUNG KWANG HWA were kept in another room - both
places being situated on the ground floor. While
confined in this cell, CHIANG HOU suggested to his
two colleagues that in order to camouflage their
real purpose with regard to their visit to Shanghai,
they should tell identical stories. It was decided
that they pretend that their arrival here was for
the purpose of devoting themselves to a peace
movement and endeavour to hoodwink the Japanese by
stating that they had interviewed Major-General ONO
(小 野 ) in Hongkong last winter in this connection.
(CHIANG HOU is said to have been approached in
Hongkong by one of his friends who was in close touch
with Major-General ONO in an endeavour to induce him
to work for the Japanese, but the effort failed).

On the day following the arrest, CHIANG HOU,
WOO NYI KENG, CHEN CHIA MO, HUNG KWANG HWA and SOO
LIANG JU were interrogated separately by a Japanese
official named HARADA (原 田 ). They were
instructed to state their antecedents, beginning
from their early life up to the present, and their
connections with General CHIANG KAI SHEK.

CHIANG HOU, WOO NYI KENG and CHEN CHIA MO
admitted they were believers in the Three People
Principles, but concealed their genuine relations

除了口头审讯外，受害者还被命令书面回答以下两个问题：
(1) 他们对日军留下的印象。
(2) 当前中日敌对状态的局势及他们的观点。

对于第一个问题，据报道，受害者对日军的训练和装备以及日本下级军官的行为给予了有利的评价，但严厉批评了日本士兵的活动。他们声称，日本下级军官因善待百姓和忠实履行职责而赢得了中国人民的钦佩，但日本士兵因缺乏纪律和勇气而受到谴责，并因在

With regard to the second question, the victims
opined that the Japanese and Chinese are all of the
same race using the same language, but instead of
cooperating to maintain their existence, the
Japanese had committed a grave blunder. They pointed
out that the Japanese have been so far able to occupy
only several railway lines and highways although
their forces have advanced to the interior of China.
In the opinion of the victims, the Japanese would
suffer heavily should the war be prolonged, and
consequently they should come to peace with China.
During interrogation, the victims were well-
treated and permitted to take seats while making
statements with the exception of HUNG KWANG HWA and
SOO LIANG JU who are said to have been subjected to
torture because they gave false statements and posed
as merchants.
On May 17, the five Chinese were brought from
their cells to a sitting room in the upstairs portion
of the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters which caused
uneasiness but were relieved on being accorded the
same good treatment. In this sitting room, they
were allowed to smoke cigarettes and read newspapers,
and such treatment was the result, it is said, of
instructions given by telegram from Major-General
ONO who was then at Tokyo.

关于第二个问题，受害者认为日本人和中国人同种同文，但日本人没有合作以维持生存，反而犯下了严重错误。他们指出，尽管日军已深入中国内地，但迄今为止仅能占领几条铁路线和公路。受害者认为，如果战争 prolonged（延长），日本将遭受惨重损失，因此他们应该与中国达成和平。在审讯期间，受害者受到了良好待遇，除洪光华和苏亮如外，其他人在陈述时均被允许就座；据说洪和苏因提供虚假陈述并伪装成商人而遭受酷刑。

On May 20, Major-General ONO arrived in
Shanghai from Tokyo by air. During an interview
with CHIANG HOU at the Japanese Gendarmerie
Headquarters, Major-General ONO requested the former
to test the attitude of the Chungking Government
towards a peace movement. CHIANG HOU pointed out
to him that so long as he was under detention, such
attempts would be futile as any telegrams despatched
in his name from Shanghai to General CHIANG KAI SHEK
would arouse suspicion in the Generalissimo's mind,
and because of this CHIANG HOU requested that he be
given his freedom in order to carry out the peace
movement. This request was accepted, and on May 23
CHIANG HOU left for Hongkong in company with two
Japanese officers detailed by Major-General ONO.
After his arrival in Hongkong, CHIANG HOU
sent a telegram to Generalissimo CHIANG and requested
him to conclude a peace pact with Japan in conformity
with the desire of the people, but no reply is said
to have been received. The two Japanese officers
later returned to Shanghai but CHIANG HOU is reported
to be still in Hongkong.
Subsequent to the release of CHIANG HOU, the
Japanese authorities ordered WOO NYI KENG and CHEN
CHIA MO, two of the victims, to write several articles
on the subject of the New Life Movement and the
People's Spiritual General Mobilization Movement,

6月9日，日本宪兵队队长山谷（YAMATONI）会见了这四名受害者，并向每人颁发了一张有效期为一个月的通行证。山谷对不得不拘禁他们表示遗憾，并劝告他们停止进一步的反日活动。在释放受害者之前，他们被告知若想见当局人员，可前往日本宪兵队总部。

(FILE C. 39.)

The case of abduction of the several Chinese
officials and Kuomintang executives which took place
on May 9 in the Foo Lai Jewish Curry Restaurant, 159
Kwangse Road, is said to have been brought to a
conclusion with the release by the Japanese authorities
of the remaining four victims namely, Woo Nyi-keng
(吳義耕) alias Woo Chuan-yung (吳垂管),
Chen Chia-mo (陳嘉謨), Hung Kwang-hwa (洪光華)
and Soo Liang-ju (蘇亮如). Information to hand
is to the effect that they were set free on June 10
through the efforts of "Mayor" Fu Siao-an and one
Teng Koo (滕固), Secretary of Mr. Wang Ching-wei
and, in this connection, Chen Chia-mo is said to have
spent some $5,000.00 to secure his freedom.

During the course of negotiation, it is
reported that the Japanese authorities insisted that
the victims would either serve in the "Reformed
Government" or devote themselves to the peace movement
as a condition for their release. With the exception
of Soo Liang-ju, who is alleged to be responsible for
supplying the information to the Japanese which led
to the abduction, and who is said to be working for
the Japanese, the three others refused to accept any
appointment of the "Reformed Government" but agreed to
participate in the peace movement, whereupon they were
released.

5月9日发生在广西路159号福莱犹太咖喱餐厅的数名中国官员及国民党执行委员绑架案，据称已随着日本当局释放剩余四名受害者而告终，这四人是：吴义耕（Woo Nyi-keng），又名吴垂管（Woo Chuan-yung）、陈嘉谟（Chen Chia-mo）、洪光华（Hung Kwang-hwa）和苏亮如（Soo Liang-ju）。现有消息称，他们于6月10日经“市长”傅筱庵和汪精卫先生秘书滕固（Teng Koo）的努力而被释放，在此过程中，据说陈嘉谟为获得自由花费了约5,000.00美元。

据报道，在谈判过程中，日本当局坚持要求受害者要么在“维新政府”中任职，要么投身和平运动，以此作为释放他们的条件。除苏亮如外，其他三人均拒绝接受“维新政府”的任何任命，但同意参与和平运动，随后获释。据称，苏亮如应对向日本人提供导致此次绑架的情报负责，且据说他正在为日本人工作。

Abduction of Chinese at the Foo Lai Jewish Curry Restaurant,
159 Kwangse Road, on May 9 - release of Chiang Hou

In connection with the abduction of the five Chinese
government officials and Kuomintang executives at the Foo
Lai Jewish Curry Restaurant, 159 Kwangse Road, on May 9,
1939, it is reported that Mr. Chiang Hou (姜豪), one
of the five victims, who is a disciple of Mr. Hwang Ching-
yoong (黃金榮), a well-known figure in the French Concession,
was released from the custody of the Japanese authorities
about three days ago. Immediately following his release,
Chiang Hou boarded a certain steamer leaving Shanghai for
Hongkong. It is learned that Mr. Chiang's release was
effected by Mr. Hwang Ching-yoong through the good offices
of Mr. Chen Chun (陳群), Minister of Interior of the
Reformed Government in Nanking, on May 23, 1939.

Endeavours are stated to have been made by interested
parties for the release of the four other persons, namely
Messrs. Woo Nyi-keng (吳義耕), alias Woo Chuan-yung (吳垂螢),
Chen Chia-mo (陳嘉謨), Soo Liang-ju (蘇亮如) and Hung
Kwang-hwa (洪光華), through Mr. Fu Siao-en (傅筱菴),
Mayor of the Shanghai City Government, who has been approached
through his wife. It is not known yet whether Fu's
assistance has produced any results.

关于1939年5月9日在广西路159号福莱犹太咖喱餐厅发生的五名中国政府官员和国民党执行委员绑架案，据报道，五名受害者之一的姜豪（Chiang Hou）先生，是法租界知名人物黄金荣（Hwang Ching-yoong）的弟子，已于大约三天前从日本当局的拘押中获释。获释后，姜豪立即登上一艘离开上海前往香港的轮船。据悉，姜豪的获释是由黄金荣通过南京“维新政府”内政部长陈群（Chen Chun）先生的斡旋，于1939年5月23日促成的。

据悉，有关方面正努力通过上海市市长傅筱庵（Fu Siao-en）先生寻求释放另外四人，即吴义耕（Woo Nyi-keng），又名吴垂萤（Woo Chuan-yung）、陈嘉谟（Chen Chia-mo）、苏亮如（Soo Liang-ju）和洪光华（Hung Kwang-hwa）先生，接触傅筱庵是通过其妻子进行的。目前尚不清楚傅的帮助是否产生了任何结果。

Synopsis of reports on several male Chinese removed by
Japanese Gendarmerie from Foo Lai Restaurant, 159 Kwangse
Road on May 9, 1939.

At 4 p.m. 9.5.39, the manager of the Foo Lai
Restaurant, 159 Kwangse Road, namely, Tsu Tsung
Tsing (朱正清), reported at Louza Police Station
that several male Chinese had been taken away from
the Restaurant by a number of Japanese accompanied
by several Chinese apparently by forcible means.

Statements concerning the incident made by the
following eyewitnesses are attached hereto :-
(1) Tsu Tsung Tsing (朱正清), manager of the
Foo Lai Restaurant, 159 Kwangse Road.
(2) Kuh Haing Foh (葛兴翰), waiter, employed
in the Foo Lai Restaurant, 159 Kwangse Road.
(3) Dzu Ying (褚英), shop assistant,
employed at 161 Kwangse Road.
(4) Tsiang Han Sing (蒋浩新), coolie, employed
at the Foo Lai Restaurant, 159 Kwangse Road.

These statements, while agreeing generally as
to the manner in which the Chinese were removed by
the Japanese, conflict in so far as the number of
Chinese taken away is concerned, this being apparently
due to the presence of Chinese agents of the Japanese
accompanying the latter.

It would appear that a person using the name
"Zung" (陳) visited the Foo Lai Restaurant on
7.5.39 and reserved Room 4, located on the first floor,
for mid-day on 9.5.39, stating that six guests were
expected to attend the Restaurant. At about noon
on 9.5.39, a male Chinese, aged about 30 years,
dressed in foreign clothing, entered Room 4. Some
10 minutes later another foreign dressed male Chinese

(1) 朱正清，广西路159号福来餐厅经理。
(2) 葛兴翰，侍者，受雇于广西路159号福来餐厅。

1939年5月9日下午3时，第五名华人男子进入4号房间，随即有两名日本人从楼下出现并紧随其后。

日本人抓住这名华人，试图将他拖出餐厅。日本人不得不使用相当大的武力来克服该华人的反抗。然而，该男子最终被制服

men were :-
(1) Chang Hou ( 姜豪 ), alias Tsang Zung Ziang
( 莊成祥 ), former member of the Executive Committee

(2) Soo Liang Ju ( 蘇亮如 ), Chief of Guards

(3) Chen Chia Mo ( 陳嘉謨 ), former Magistrate

(4) Woo Chuan Yung ( 吳傳瑩 ), former Commander

(5) Hung Kwang Hua ( 洪光華 ), member of the

Confidential information received is to the
effect that No.4 above, namely, Woo Chuan Yung, has
close connection with Doeng Ying Pah ( 董行白 ),

根据收到的信息，被绑架者为：
(1) 姜豪，别名莊成祥，前当地党部执行委员会委员，现任新生活运动主任。
(2) 蘇亮如，宝山区警卫队队长，据称曾任江苏省保安司令部参谋长。
(3) 陳嘉謨，前宝山区县长。
(4) 吳傳瑩，前江湾商团团长。
(5) 洪光華，宝山区国民党总部执行委员会委员。

收到的机密情报显示，上述第4人，即吴传镛，与当地国民党总部委员董行白（地址不详，目前负责监督上海党部活动）关系密切。

party at the Foo Lai Restaurant on May 9, 1939 in
honour of Chang Hou, Soo Liang Ju and Chen Chia Mo,
aforesaid, who are reported to have arrived in
Shanghai about the middle of April, 1939, for the
purpose of assisting one Zung Yee-dong (鄭頤同),
ex-magistrate of Nanking, a former deputy of political
administration of the Kiangsu Provincial Government
and a close follower of Chen Koo-fu (陳果夫),
Chairman of the Kiangsu Provincial Government, who
was directly nominated by General Chiang Kai-shek in
January, 1939, as the Special Deputy responsible for
Party, Political and Military Affairs in Shanghai -
in reality, to supercede Doong Ying Pah.

Zung Yee Dong is reported to have distributed
a total of $200,000.00 in local newspaper circles in
order to obviate possible opposition against his
appointment. The appointment of Zung Yee Dong is
reported to have incensed Doong Ying Pah with the
result that Chen Koo-fu in order to avoid friction
appealed to Tu Yueh Sung (杜月笙) of whom Doong
Ying Pah is a follower, to smooth matters out and to
offer Doong Ying Pah the post of Secretary after
Zung Yee Dong had assumed office. A compromise was
in this way reached, whereupon Zung Yee Dong appointed
Chang Hou as Chief of Party Affairs Department;
Chen Chia Mo as Chief of Political Affairs Department
and Soo Liang Ju, Chief of Military Affairs Department

据称，吴传镛安排了1939年5月9日在福来餐厅举行的午宴，以欢迎上述姜豪、苏亮如和陈嘉謨。据报道，这些人于1939年4月中旬抵达上海，目的是协助郑颐同——前南京县长，前江苏省政府政务副厅长，江苏省政府主席陈果夫的亲信——后者于1939年1月直接由蒋委员长提名，担任负责上海党务、政务和军事事务的特派副专员——实际上是为了取代董行白。

据报道，郑颐同为了消除对其任命的可能反对，在当地新闻界散布了总计200,000.00美元。郑颐同的任命据称激怒了董行白，导致陈果夫为避免摩擦，求助于董行白的追随者杜月笙，以缓和局势，并提议在郑颐同就职后给予董行白秘书一职。以此方式达成了妥协，随后郑颐同任命姜豪为党务处处长；陈嘉謨为政务处处长；苏亮如为军事处处长

Shanghai Municipality Party, Political and Military
Affairs. In view of the foregoing it is suspected

Doong Ying Pah connived with the Japanese to have
the abduction carried out.
